note: Hand-written questions with the document that must be retrieved to answer them. Written by reading the content, not by running the retriever — otherwise the set measures the retriever against itself. Product-name queries were added 2026-08-23: the set had 30 questions and NONE named a product, so recall of 0.900 was measured while "what is fusegrid" returned nothing. Every question was phrased the way the content is written, which tests whether prose retrieves its own prose. A visitor types the product name first. The site has no `projects/trigsight` page — it IS trigsight — so questions about it by name are deliberately absent from this set rather than recorded as permanent misses. Tracked as a content gap, not a retrieval one.
